article.headline: Thames scores 16 as Saint Louis defeats Richmond 88-63
article.description: — Kellen Thames scored 16 points off of the bench to help lead Saint Louis past Richmond 88-63 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Thames scores 16 as Saint Louis defeats Richmond 88-63
article.story: ST. LOUIS -- — Kellen Thames scored 16 points off of the bench to help lead Saint Louis past Richmond 88-63 on Saturday. Thames added five rebounds for the Billikens (17-1, 5-0 Atlantic 10 Conference). Robbie Avila scored 14 points and added six rebounds. Amari McCottry shot 4 for 7 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 12 points, and added six rebounds. The Billikens picked up their 11th straight win. AJ Lopez led the way for the Spiders (13-6, 3-3) with 20 points and two blocks. Will Harper III added 17 points for Richmond. Saint Louis took the lead for good with 18:42 left in the first half. The score was 43-22 at halftime, with Thames racking up eight points. Saint Louis extended its lead to 58-29 during the second half, fueled by an 8-0 scoring run. Trey Green scored a team-high nine points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
